heading: Tonight
text: A few stray evening showers, then periods of clouds in the northern mountains, with clearing in the Champlain and St. Lawrence Valleys, and south. Blustery and colder. Lows in the 30s, near 30 over the higher terrain north. Winds northwest 10 to 20 mph, gusting 25 to 35 mph.

heading: Tuesday
text: Mostly sunny, except morning clouds through the northern mountains giving way to increasing afternoon sun. Breezy and chilly. Highs only in the upper 40s to low 50s north, in the 50s south. Winds northwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting 25 to 35 mph.

heading: Tuesday Night
text: Mostly clear, with some high clouds late through Quebec into the Adirondacks and north of Rt. 2. Patchy valley fog. Areas of frost and freezing temperatures. Lows in the 30s, some 20s in the cold spots. Winds northwest 10 to 15 mph, becoming light in sheltered valleys.

heading: Wednesday
text: Partly sunny north, and sun mixing with clouds south. A chance of a few showers in the St. Lawrence Valley. Highs 60 to 65, mid 60s in the Champlain and southern valleys. Winds light, becoming south near 10 mph east, 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph from the Green Mountains west.
